caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a predominantly yellowish or beige background. The rim and inner circles of the plate are outlined in brown. Green vines with leaves and flowers, accented with purple and brown, form a decorative border along the edge and inner band of the plate. In the center of the plate, there is an illustration of a fish lying horizontally with a single green stalk or reed behind it. Surrounding the central image are hand-written inscriptions in brown or green, reading: "The fishes of the Spey. 1862" in the center, with additional text along the inner rim. The plate is drawn with shading below it to create a sense of depth, and the artist's signature, "E. N. Shelled," along with the date "1/1/87," is located at the bottom right of the image. The plate is presented against a plain, light beige background.
title: Pa. German Dish
